deep_validation.analyzer: Before import, the supplied descriptor must equal final_analyzer_dependency, resolve to the canonical analyzer path in a clean checkout whose HEAD is study_commit, and byte-match git show study_commit at that path. The signed final analysis is then replayed byte-for-object from its hash-bound analysis_evidence_manifest.
deep_validation.confirmation_evidence: Before import, compiler_source must resolve to its canonical path in the same clean study_commit checkout and byte-match the trusted Git blob. Only then may its _validate_compiled_bundle replay the complete source-only confirmation bundle.
deep_validation.fixture: Before import, fixture_freeze_dependency must resolve to its canonical path in the same clean study_commit checkout and byte-match the trusted Git blob. All C01-C24 rows are then deep-replayed and every authenticated aggregate must bind the supplied fixture-freeze descriptor.
deep_validation.labels: The final analyzer claim gate, nonempty reproduced human-consensus inventory, annotation freeze, final consensus, and outcome-blind request selection are mandatory.
deep_validation.private_videos: The inventory must be the exact compiler-receipt output. Every retained descriptor is hash checked; every declared example is uniquely joined and re-hashed.
deep_validation.source_drift: All direct inputs, the analysis evidence manifest, selected pose manifests, and selected source videos are re-hashed immediately before atomic publication.
deep_validation.publication_source: The signed input supplies full publication_source_commit P, which must equal the executing repository HEAD. A deployment-only publish/origin sanity check permits only credential-free canonical repository URLs. Independently, read authentication invokes the literal public HTTPS URL https://github.com/adeeb10abbas/steerable.git in a fresh template-free bare repository, with inherited Git/SSH/helper/executable/config state scrubbed, exact inert local config, and a protected allowlisted /usr/bin/git or /usr/local/bin/git binary. Exact refs/heads/codex/forecast-layout-gm-20260912 is observed, fetched with a 1048576-byte blob filter, and observed again at stable remote commit R; the isolated graph is capped at 201326592 bytes and must prove study_commit <= P <= R. Compiler, contract, analyzer, confirmation compiler, and fixture-validator blobs are read from that graph and matched to executing/source-checkout bytes before import. The complete isolated authentication repeats before atomic rename.

input_manifest.copy_selected_videos: Boolean signed into the manifest; false emits only hash-bound public video metadata. When true, every selected MP4 must be copied byte-identically, each file must be at most 16777216 bytes, and the complete selected set must be at most 67108864 bytes.
input_manifest.payload_signature: SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON with payload_sha256 removed
input_manifest.publication_source_commit: Full Git object ID P containing exact tracked copies of this compiler and contract. P must equal local HEAD and be an ancestor of the stable fetched authorized control-ref head R; dirty, untracked, mismatched, divergent, or unpublished local source is rejected.

publication_source_remote.authenticated_read: The literal authorized public HTTPS URL and exact ref are read in a fresh template-free bare repository; aliases and executing-checkout config are never used for read trust. System/global config and inherited Git, SSH, askpass, credential-helper, executable-path and URL-rewrite state are disabled or scrubbed. The exact core-only local config is restored after filtered fetch before object reads.
publication_source_remote.credential_policy: No credential-bearing URL is accepted or emitted. Exact GitHub SSH forms for adeeb10abbas/steerable are accepted only for the deployment-route check after raw and expanded fetch/push URL validation; authenticated reads always use the pinned literal public HTTPS URL and sanitized failures disclose no command, URL or Git stderr.

outputs.actual_scene_timing.json: Signed, path-free actual robot-base fixture geometry and exact per-model qualified timing fields.
outputs.build_receipt.json: Signed receipt binding every other output by relative path, bytes, and SHA-256, plus the local publication source P and separately authenticated remote control head R; its own payload_sha256 is the self-binding.
outputs.coverage_by_condition.csv: Per-model, per-condition denominator-preserving status and observability counts.
outputs.example_videos.json: Signed declared-rule selection and unique private-video join, with no private source paths.
outputs.forecast_skill_layout_effects.json: Signed separate-model primary forecast skill and reflected-minus-original layout-effect inputs.
outputs.model_results.csv: Separate-model skill, baselines, uncertainty, missingness bounds, reflection discrepancy, and status counts.
outputs.model_results_table.tex: Generated table fragment only; it never edits or generates a manuscript.
outputs.paper_evidence.json: Signed compact evidence object preserving all required analysis components and claim boundaries.
outputs.videos/: Optional byte-identical selected MP4 copies, bounded to 16777216 bytes per file and 67108864 bytes total to match the deployed publication copier limits. No transcoding or outcome-based replacement is permitted.
